/*AdmTranTxnDAO.listAdmTranTxn 어드민사용자거래내역 목록 조회 */ SELECT A.INQRY_DT -- 조회일자 , A.USER_ID -- 사용자아이디 , (SELECT USER_NM FROM ADM_USER_BAS WHERE USER_ID = A.USER_ID) AS USER_NM , B.ADM_BZWK_LCLS_CD-- 어드민업무대분류코드 , (SELECT CD_NM FROM CMN_CD WHERE CD_GROUP_VAL = 'ADM_BZWK_LCLS_CD' AND CD_VAL = B.ADM_BZWK_LCLS_CD AND USE_YN = 'Y') AS ADM_BZWK_LCLS_CD_NM -- 어드민업무대분류 , B.SCREN_TRAN_NM -- 화면거래명 , B.SCREN_TRAN_ID -- 화면거래아이디 , COUNT(A.USER_ID) AS INQRY_CNT -- 조회건수 FROM ADM_TRAN_TXN A -- 어드민사용자거래내역 INNER JOIN ADM_SCREN_TRAN_BAS B -- 어드민화면거래기본 ON A.SCREN_TRAN_ID = B.SCREN_TRAN_ID WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY A.INQRY_DT, A.USER_ID, B.SCREN_TRAN_ID, B.ADM_BZWK_LCLS_CD, B.SCREN_TRAN_NM ORDER BY A.INQRY_DT DESC, A.USER_ID, B.SCREN_TRAN_NM

/*AdmTranTxnDAO.listAllAdmTranTxn 어드민사용자거래내역 목록 조회 엑셀 */ SELECT A.INQRY_DT -- 조회일자 , A.USER_ID -- 사용자아이디 , (SELECT USER_NM FROM ADM_USER_BAS WHERE USER_ID = A.USER_ID) AS USER_NM , B.ADM_BZWK_LCLS_CD-- 어드민업무대분류코드 , (SELECT CD_NM FROM CMN_CD WHERE CD_GROUP_VAL = 'ADM_BZWK_LCLS_CD' AND CD_VAL = B.ADM_BZWK_LCLS_CD AND USE_YN = 'Y') AS ADM_BZWK_LCLS_CD_NM -- 어드민업무대분류 , B.SCREN_TRAN_NM -- 화면거래명 , B.SCREN_TRAN_ID -- 화면거래아이디 , COUNT(A.USER_ID) AS INQRY_CNT -- 조회건수 FROM ADM_TRAN_TXN A -- 어드민사용자거래내역 INNER JOIN ADM_SCREN_TRAN_BAS B -- 어드민화면거래기본 ON A.SCREN_TRAN_ID = B.SCREN_TRAN_ID WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY A.INQRY_DT, A.USER_ID, B.SCREN_TRAN_ID, B.ADM_BZWK_LCLS_CD, B.SCREN_TRAN_NM ORDER BY A.INQRY_DT DESC, A.USER_ID, B.SCREN_TRAN_NM

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_COUNT FROM ( SELECT 1 FROM ADM_TRAN_TXN A -- 어드민사용자거래내역 INNER JOIN ADM_SCREN_TRAN_BAS B -- 어드민화면거래기본 ON A.SCREN_TRAN_ID = B.SCREN_TRAN_ID WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY A.INQRY_DT, A.USER_ID, B.SCREN_TRAN_ID, B.ADM_BZWK_LCLS_CD, B.SCREN_TRAN_NM )
